description: Every check common-checks runs, and the modules that carry each one's rules. Consumers that re-run these checks outside a workflow read this file so they cannot drift from the composite. Paths are repo-relative. A check with no modules states why nothing importable carries its rule.

checks.name: run-once
checks.reason: it claims the workflow run for one job. There is no rule a file can break.
